title: DVendo DITO Load transfer pushed and destination main verified
summary: After the owner confirmed the scoped Codespaces secret setup was ready, restored the independent application from the saved bundle and verified its SHA-256 against the prior transfer record. Used the transfer credential only for the exact ByteSpectreX/dvendo-dito-load repository through a command-scoped Git helper, without printing or persisting the credential value or replacing source-repository authentication. Initial sandbox remote inspection failed DNS resolution; the supported elevated retry succeeded and showed an empty destination. Inspected the included CI workflow, which performs validation and a Cloudflare dry run rather than deployment. A normal non-force push created destination main, and a separate authenticated ls-remote confirmed 08216492d41807a2866dc00ccb49a7cce092e8d0, matching the prepared bundle. The destination contains the two independent transfer commits. Existing source checkout edits and its origin were retained. No new test run or CI result is claimed; prior offline validation remains documented in the earlier transfer record. No deployment or provider transaction occurred.

evidence.description: Destination inspected empty before successful normal push; remote main subsequently matched the prepared commit.

nextSteps: Continue application development in ByteSpectreX/dvendo-dito-load using its continuation guide.
Review the destination repository Actions results separately; the transfer verification establishes remote commit identity, not a passing CI run.
